    edge_runs=[]
    for r in (0,h-1):
        cols=[c for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x!=bg]

    pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and not any(r==rr and lo<=c<=hi for rr,lo,hi,_ in edge_runs)]
